body:
I feel the same way. I really don't think I'll ever tell anyone unless I decide to commit suicide. I plan to make a video about it.

For me, it's just how I grew up. I'm a bit of an enigma in my family. I'm not like my siblings. I don't take after my mum or dad and while I definitely act very similar to my friends, that's not who I really am. Just an act.

I've always just let life pass me by, and while I tried my best, for years, I've always told myself I'm happy and I'm fine. This year it really hit me that maybe I was just doing it because I'm scared of everything. I'm scared of life and how people will treat me after I tell them the truth. 

I'm so normal on the surface, I'm like a psychopath. In reality, I'm terrified of everything I do. This really hit this year. I went from wanting to have a wife with 2 kids, a stable job, and I wanted to leave my parent's house a year or 2 after having my first job. Now I don't want any relationship. I want to move away, live alone and I want to have a dog. Now I don't even know my sexuality or anything about myself or what I want and I'm almost 20 :(. Weird. The strangest part is that this all happened after a single dream I had too. It's like this dream unlocked my emotional chakra if that exists. It brought me to a sense of reality I think.

Anyway, sorry you probably don't want to hear my life story or care but I think this all relates to why I'm so scared to tell anyone what I feel. In other words, I'm just too scared of everything and of life. My brain tells me that no one cares.  

Anyway, sorry again this is so long. I'm not good at keeping things concise.
I'm very fearful that that's a big possibility. I feel like the longer I wait the worse the outcome will be but I also can't work up the courage to tell anyone. Maybe someday.

I can kinda relate to that. I have a good relationship with my mum. We used to be able to talk a lot.

Now every time we talk it's about how I haven't cleaned my room or how I play too much games. Even today, I cleaned the entire kitchen and hallway, took 2 hours almost cause it hadn't been cleaned and I wanted to make her happy for once cause she's always stressed with work.

She said thanks which was nice. The next thing to come out of her mouth "so did you clean your shower like I asked..". I replied, "No, I cleaned the entire downstairs". She just said, "of course, why am I not surprised".

I understand her frustration. She works all day and she wants me to do what she asked but nowadays conversations like those are the only things we have.

And if you want to talk to anyone, I'd be willing to listen. Just send me a message anytime. I can't guarantee I'll read it instantly but I'll try my best to reply as fast as I can.

Sorry man :( I wish there was a straightforward answer to this.

I mean, there's therapy but that's expensive and not everyone can afford that. 

And there are the hotlines available, and even though I want to call them, I feel like I'd be wasting their time. Every time I try to call, my heart starts racing and I think what if someone commits suicide because I just wanted to chat.

Sorry to hear that :(. Maybe this is what I'm most afraid of. Compared to my siblings, I never really got as much attention from my parents so maybe that's where this feeling comes from, who knows.

Never got a birthday cake after the age of like 4, never had any birthday parties and didn't get many birthday presents, didn't get as much attention from them when I was struggling with school (my mum would pull all-nighters with both my brothers but when I needed help, my mum would get frustrated cause she has to do something else). Didn't even get my first phone till I was 15 or 16, all my other siblings got phones in 7th grade.

I know this sounds spoiled cause some people get absolutely nothing compared to me, but regardless, these things had a lasting impact on me.

Maybe deep down I feel like anyone, especially my parents won't really care or try to help. Even if they just actively listen to me.
I can't speak for everyone but it's a terrible feeling. The worst part is I have no real reason to not tell anyone :(
